sourceTitle: How to make Bombay Toastie Sandwich
sourceText:
How to make Bombay Toastie Sandwich
By: Rahul Upadhyay
Published: Thursday, September 28, 2017 - 2:01am

Ingredients




Brown bread: 4 slices
Boiled and mashed potatoes: 1 cup
Kissan Sweet and Spicy Sauce: 2 tablespoons
Jeera: 1/2 teaspoon
Mustard seeds: 1/2 teaspoon
Boiled green peas: 1 tablespoon
Garam masala: 1/2 teaspoon
Chopped green chillies: 1 teaspoon
Oil: 1 tablespoon
Turmeric: 1/4 teaspoon
Salt to taste
A pinch of pepper
Lemon juice: 1 teaspoon
Green chutney: 1 tablespoon
Butter: 1 teaspoon

Preparation

1 Heat oil in a pan. Add cumin seeds and mustard seeds. Once mustard seeds crackle, add green chilies, turmeric powder, mashed potatoes and green peas. 2 Stir. Add in Kissan Sweet and Spicy Sauce and some salt. Stir 3 Take it off the flame 4 On bread slice, apply butter and green chutney. Now apply this potato mixture 5 Pan grill this sandwich and serve.

About

Bombay Toastie Sandwich Recipe is one of the best healthy snack recipe.  Bombay Toast Sandwich Recipe is must have Tiffin Snack for your kid.
The Bombay Toastie Masala Sandwich is a delicious twist to your regular Aloo/Potato Sandwich. This Veg Grilled Toast Sandwich by Shagun is easy to make. Kissan Fresh Tomato Ketchup in this recipe boosts the flavor of your child’s tiffin.
